info.title: I Colori Dell’Anima (ITA)
info.synopsis: Totsuko, una liceale che frequenta la Christian Academy di Nagasaki, ha un potere davvero particolare: riesce a vedere i "colori" delle emozioni nel cuore delle persone. Per impedire ai suoi amici e alla sua famiglia di provare sentimenti oscuri, si preoccupa, legge le situazioni e arriva persino a mentire per appianare discussioni e litigi. Un giorno, in una libreria antiquaria, incontra una bella ragazza con emozioni di un colore incredibilmente vivace e un ragazzo amante della musica che cerca di mettere insieme un gruppo musicale. La storia segue queste tre persone particolarmente sensibili che si riuniscono con l'intento di formare una band.

info.title: Mobile Suit Gundam Thunderbolt: December Sky (ITA)
info.synopsis: La storia si apre nel settore Thunderbolt, una zona spaziale squassata di continuo da imponenti fulmini, che poco tempo prima ospitava la colonia di Side 4, Mua. Qui è facile avanzare di grado: basta sopravvivere abbastanza a lungo alla carneficina infinita perché l’avanzamento sia assicurato. Completamente distrutta da un’azione bellica, l’area presenta ora un desolante panorama di detriti, utilizzati da uno sparuto gruppo di soldati di Zeon come nascondiglio per i loro appostamenti. I cecchini della Divisione Living Dead sono sfruttati come cavie per il nuovo Psycho Zaku, che solo un menomato privo sia di mani che di piedi può manovrare. I loro avversari sono i sopravvissuti di Side 4, appartenenti all’Esercito della Federazione Terrestre. In questo conflitto, che si è subito portato via tutti i veterani di guerra e che esige ingenti perdite a ogni scorreria, non sorprende che i combattenti si affidino alla musica per trovare conforto: jazz per il pilota Io Fleming, cui verrà affidato un Gundam sperimentale, scelte ancora più retrò per il più forte dei suoi avversari della Divisione Living Dead, Daryl Lorenz.

episodes.title: Complete Movie
episodes.synopsis: During the One Year War of U.C. 0079, the Earth Federation and Principality of Zeon engage in a fierce battle at the "Thunderbolt Sector", a shoal zone in the former Colony Side 4 "Moore". After successfully infiltrating Zeon's sniper field, ace Federation pilot and jazz enthusiast Io Fleming is given control of the latest Gundam prototype.

info.title: Ingress: The Animation (ITA)
info.synopsis: Sin da quando era piccolo, Makoto possiede uno strano potere che gli permette di leggere la memoria degli oggetti che tocca. Nascondendo questo potere, lavora come agente speciale nelle forze dell'ordine ed un giorno, mentre investigava sulle cause di un'esplosione in un laboratorio che faceva ricerche su una sostanza misteriosa, chiamata "XM", entra in contatto con delle memorie misteriose dell'anello di Sarah, unica sopravvissuta dell'incidente. Ciò che mostra la memoria è una sagoma di una persona mentre scompare in una luce rossa. Makoto viene subito immischiato in un'enorme cospirazione. La battaglia per "XM", un materiale in grado di avere effetti sulla mente umana, inizia ora...

episodes.title: Begin / Danger / Message
episodes.synopsis: Able to see the memories of anything he touches, Special Agent Makoto Midorikawa is asked to help investigate the scene of a mysterious gas explosion.

episodes.title: Escape / Past / Destiny
episodes.synopsis: A Sensitive himself, agent of the Resistance Jack Norman uses his extrasensory "flash forward" ability to pursue former XM researcher Sarah Coppola.

episodes.title: Advance / Discover / Conflict
episodes.synopsis: Sarah and Makoto head to the secret Hulong lab deep in the woods of Kyoto, but they're confronted by Liu's security forces and Jack along the way.

episodes.title: Separate / Together / Pursue
episodes.synopsis: Overwhelmed by the incoming security force, Sarah gives herself up in order to spare Makoto's life but is double crossed by Liu soon after.

episodes.title: Journey / Portal / Potential
episodes.synopsis: After securing fake passports from a professional forger named Zion, Makoto and Jack Norman board a flight to Switzerland to rescue Sarah from Hulong.

episodes.title: Enlightenment / Resistance / Chaos
episodes.synopsis: While Hulong scientists test the effects of dark XM on Sarah's body, her heightened ability enables her to speak to Makoto through the portal network.

episodes.title: Nature / Civilization / Soul
episodes.synopsis: Aided by protectors of an ancient holy site, Makoto uses his powers to look for an escape route while hired mercenaries close in on their position.

episodes.title: Forget / Data / Rebel
episodes.synopsis: En route to rescuing Sarah inside CERN, Makoto and Jack are contacted by "ADA," the AI program originally created to analyze complex XM data.

episodes.title: Live / Die / Truth
episodes.synopsis: When Jack’s body begins to fail him, Liu reveals how far Christopher Brandt went in harnessing the Dark XM’s ungodly powers.

episodes.title: Destroy / Create / Answer
episodes.synopsis: With red portals overtaking the entire XM network, those wearing goggles embedded with Dark XM matter begin to collapse in agonizing pain.

episodes.title: Us / Them / All
episodes.synopsis: The true mastermind’s diabolical plan moves one step closer to completion. Meanwhile, Makoto faces Liu, who's hellbent on finishing what he started.

info.title: Lamù - Remember My Love
info.synopsis: In un flashback sì scopre che,quando nacque Lamù, una strega inviò una maledizione, per vendicarsi di non essere stata invitata alla festa per la neonata. Questa maledizione consisteva nell'impossibilità per Lamù di essere felice una volta che avesse trovato il suo vero amore. Intanto, tornati al presente, un misterioso parco dei divertimenti, il "Tomobiki Märchenland" è comparso dal nulla, scatenando una grande curiosità generale. Ataru, Lamù e gli altri amici si recano già al giorno dell'apertura, ma durante uno show di magia, il prestigiatore trasforma Ataru in un ippopotamo rosa per poi sparire nel nulla insieme all'intero parco. Lamù si mette subito sulle tracce del misterioso prestigiatore per poter far tornare Ataru normale, notando che le cose inizieranno a diventare molto strane e veloci.

episodes.title: Complete Movie
episodes.synopsis: Lamù - Beautiful Dreamer è il secondo film cinematografico ispirato ai personaggi di Lamù creati da Rumiko Takahashi.A causa di un desiderio, espresso quasi involontariamente da Lamù al folletto Mujaki, Tomobiki si ritrova costretta a vivere continuamente la stessa giornata. Nessuno sembra rendersene conto, tranne il professor Onsen. Le cose precipitano però quando tutti gli abitanti della città spariscono, lasciando tutto in rovina, ad esclusione di casa Moroboshi, in cui Ataru, Lamù e i loro amici continuano a vivere, "quasi" normalmente. Il desiderio espresso da Lamù al magico folletto dei sogni era stato che nulla cambiasse mai, in relazione al fatto che la ragazza era felice così come stavano le cose. Tutto degenera quindi in funzione ai desideri, anche quelli non espressi, dalla ragazza. Affinché tutto torni alla normalità, Ataru dovrà affrontare un bizzarro viaggio all'interno dei sogni.

info.title: Dogs: Bullets & Carnage
info.synopsis: In una futura città europea, Mihai Mihaeroff, un ex assassino; Badou Nails, un mercenario con una benda sull'occhio e dipendenza dal fumo; Fuyumine Naoto, un'orfana armata di katana; e Heine Rammsteiner, un albino geneticamente modificato armato di pistole, esercitano i loro mestieri mortali per le strade e nel mondo sotterraneo.

episodes.title: Weepy Old Killer
episodes.synopsis: Mihai's story. It's about his life as a hitman, what happened to the one woman he loved, and how he faced a demon born through his training.

episodes.title: Gun Smoker
episodes.synopsis: Badou's story. A hilarious story about how he's chased all around the city for taking a picture of a gang lord doing something really embarrassing. you figure out whether he has the guts to take a beating at the end of the chapter.

episodes.title: Blade Maiden
episodes.synopsis: Naoto's story. It explains why she's so vengeful, how she got her training with the sword, and how she got the scar on her chest.

episodes.title: Stray Dogs Howling in the Dark
episodes.synopsis: Haine's story. He is touched by a rare sense of heart when he sees a winged girl bought by some rich man and tries to save her.

info.title: Gene Shaft
info.synopsis: Dopo aver superato una crisi che li ha portati sull'orlo della distruzione, nel XXIII secolo l'umanità ha raggiunto una stabilità grazie all'ingegneria genetica con cui ha soppresso sentimenti come l'amore e la ricerca del potere. Le nascite sono controllate e si ha un rapporto uomini:donne di 1:9. Il valore e la funzione dell'individuo all'interno della società viene decisa dalla qualità del DNA. La storia ha inizio quando, 5 anni prima, appare un misterioso anello di cinquecento chilometri nell'orbita terrestre. Per indagare sul misterioso oggetto verranno inviati degli individui con specifiche caratteristiche genetiche e con l'obbiettivo di contenere qualsiasi minaccia per l'umanità.

episodes.title: Inherit the Stars
episodes.synopsis: Mika Seido is on her way to her new assignment. She arrives at Maracanan Station. There she meets an old friend, Sofia, who is like a big sister to her. The happiness of their reunion is cut short, however, when Hiroto Amagiwa enters the room. Since heâ€™s a man, heâ€™s heavily guarded. Mika recognizes him as the one responsible for the death of her best friend, Ryoko. She tries to get to him, but she fails due to the high security around him. Mika and Sofia then decide to head to the bar. There they meet two other members of their new team, Tiki and Mario Musicanova, who are brother and sister. Mika is amazed, because siblings are very rare in the genetically engineered society. Elsewhere, Lord Sergei Sneak IV is making preparations. With him is his Register, Sibyl. On the Ring, Mir, arguably the most perfect human in existence, is on a mission. She encounters some rebels who attack the Ring and barely escapes. Through the struggle, there's an explosion that does some damage

episodes.title: The Ship Who Sang
episodes.synopsis: Maracanan Station is damaged and falls out of orbit. Will the people on board survive? And, can Mika and the others save the day?

episodes.title: Rendezvous in Space
episodes.synopsis: Now that everyone is aboard the Bilkis and the S-Mission has begun. Sergei orders the Ring destroyed. Mika, meanwhile, is selected to pilot the Shaft, with Sofia acting as the backup pilot. It's a dangerous mission, as the Shaft is still very buggy, and no one is really sure how to operate it. Onboard the ship, the squabbling between the debuggers and the operations staff gets out of hand. The other members of the mission, Tiki, Mir, Remmy, and Mario, can only watch and wait. Things start to look even worse when the Ring notices the Shaft and scans it.

episodes.title: The Sentinel
episodes.synopsis: When Captain Amagiwa and the others are attacked by a Ring, can Mika and the others defeat it?

episodes.title: Angels and Spaceships
episodes.synopsis: The Bilkis has been boarded by a Ring that can copy human form. When it copies an individual, it drains them of blood and leaves them in a comatose state. Once this Ring is discovered, a shipwide search begins. Mika encounters Hiroto and believes that he's the Ring. To prove his identity, he relays details of the incident in which Ryoko died and he survived.

episodes.title: Hotline from the Past
episodes.synopsis: A strange vessel is detected and taken aboard the Bilkis. It turns out to be a space shuttle from 21st century Earth. Three male astronauts are alive inside. The crew of the Bilkis regards them as primitives, little better than Neanderthals, as they come from the time when humanity almost destroyed itself. However, Mika takes pity on them and tries to befriend them, sneaking them around the ship. But the astronauts may prove the fears about them true. They storm the bridge and take it by force!

episodes.title: Ring World
episodes.synopsis: The Ring that took the astronauts now attacks the Bilkis. Even worse, Beatrice is still unconscious from when the brain shut down from information overload. Hiroto passes out in the middle of the battle, and Mario assumes command of the Bilkis. Mika battles the Ring alone in the Shaft, but Mir suddenly switches positions and takes the main driver's seat. Before she can do anything, though, a script executes. The Shaft performs a new, incredible maneuver that destroys the Ring. Unfortunately, this only leads to the appearance of multiple Rings!

episodes.title: The Moon is a Harsh Master
episodes.synopsis: The crew of the Bilkis has been declared traitors by the I.E.O. To make matters worse, the I.E.S.A. fleet is pursuing them. With Captain Amagiwa still unconscious, the role of captain falls upon Mario. Meanwhile, Remmy's true nature is revealed: She's a terrorist working to restore the "natural" order of things. And she's working for Sergei! She announces this to the entire crew of the Bilkis. Mir doesn't take it well. They're both out to destroy the Council of Elders and the I.E.O. But Sergei's plans go even further than that. When she finds out what he really plans, will she turn against him, even at the cost of her own life?

episodes.title: Less Than Human
episodes.synopsis: The I.E.S.A. fleet arrives. Mario bargains with the fleet commander, who's an old friend, to buy the ship a little more time. But there's a wild card in the deck. Jean Gadot, who harbors an intense hatred of Mario, decides to take matters into his own hands. He stages an "accident" in which the fleet commander's ship is destroyed. Will his plan succeed?

episodes.title: The Men Women Don`t See
episodes.synopsis: With little choices left, Mario decides to assassinate Jean. Will his plan work?

episodes.title: Rite of Passage
episodes.synopsis: Shaken by recent events, the crew struggles on. Tiki blames Mika for Mario's death. Even Beatrice grieves for Mario. Mika is told that Hiroto's chances of recovery are slim. Mir steals the Shaft and goes off to Ganymede to confront Sergei about his betrayal. Mika pursues her, but is unsuccessful in bringing Mir back. So Sofia is sent after both Mir and Mika. Meanwhile, Dolce finally finishes debugging the Shaft. On Niven Base, Mir confronts Sergei, who says he was waiting for her to come and everything is as planned. A new type of Ring appears in space and attacks the Bilkis.

episodes.title: The Gentle Man of Ganymede
episodes.synopsis: Oberus is closer than originally thought! It's housed on Europa, another of Jupiter's moons. Hiroto wakes from his coma and tells them to scan the surface of Europa. He then gives orders to attack it. Beatrice breaks down and leaves the bridge. Meanwhile, Sergei tells Mir that humanity is nothing more than a "bug" in the universal program. A bug he will eliminate. When Hiroto orders Sofia to use the Shaft, she refuses. So Hiroto uses the Shaft to teleport himself to the surface of Europa with a bomb. Mika sets off to get him back. And Sergei has his own plans to stop Hiroto.

episodes.title: Childhood`s Beginning
episodes.synopsis: Rings begin to appear around the sun. The rings cover the sun in an attempt to extinguish it, following Oberus' final program. Mir intercepts Mika and they fight, Shaft to Shaft. However, Mika finally wins out and convinces Mir to return to the Bilkis to be with her friends. On the moon below, Sergei lectures Hiroto about how human DNA has too many errors. He says that it cannot be cleansed, so he's going to destroy all humanity. Hiroto fights Sergei, but it's going to take Mika to finally settle the score and humanity's fate.

info.title: Love Hina Christmas Movie (ITA)
info.synopsis: Mentre si avvicinano nuovi esami preliminari per Keitaro, arriva anche il Natale. Si dice che, essendo la prima vigilia di Natale del millennio, se qualcuno confesserà il proprio amore in questa serata speciale, il suo desiderio si avvererà. Keitaro ha deciso cosa fare quella vigilia: confessare il suo amore a Naru. Ma uno studente ripetente come lui può permettersi di distogliere l'attenzione dagli esami proprio quel giorno? E soprattutto, non sarà l'unico a confessarsi quella notte...

episodes.title: TV Special
episodes.synopsis: Keitaro decides whether or not to confess his love to Naru. Eventually he confesses, but Naru's reaction is not as he had hoped.

info.title: HeartCatch Pretty Cure! - Un lupo mannaro a Parigi (ITA)
info.synopsis: Le Pretty Cure vanno a Parigi per partecipare alla sfilata di moda della nuova linea di abiti creata dalla mamma di Erika. Nella capitale francese si trovano ad affrontare il Barone Salamandra, primo Messaggero del Deserto, liberato dal confinamento nella cappella di Mont Saint-Michel, dove era stato intrappolato quattrocento anni prima dalla prima Pretty Cure, Cure Anje. A donargli la libertà è stato un ragazzino, chiamato poi Olivier da Tsubomi, che, dopo aver viaggiato per tutto il mondo con il Barone, ha deciso di ribellarsi a lui e ai suoi piani di distruzione sottraendogli la pietra che racchiude il suo potere..

episodes.title: Complete Movie
episodes.synopsis: In Paris to model on a fashion show organized by Erika's mother, the Pretty Cure meet a mysterious boy who is being chased by an ancient Desert Apostle named Count Salamander. The young boy introduces himself as Loup Garou and he wishes to make Salamander give up on his desire to destroy the world after being imprisoned for over 400 years.

info.title: Touring After the Apocalypse
info.synopsis: Completamente sole dopo la fine della civiltà, due ragazze cavalcano una moto tra le rovine desolate del Giappone, ma non hanno intenzione di lasciare che tutto questo ostacoli il loro giro turistico! Dalle sorgenti termali di Hakone all'enorme Tokyo Big Sight, hanno a disposizione tutti per loro i luoghi turistici più popolari della nazione, quindi perché non approfitarne?

episodes.title: Hakone
episodes.synopsis: This is a post-apocalyptic world. Yoko and Airi travel freely on their electric bike, Serow. Their destination this time is Hakone.

episodes.title: Yokohama, Yokosuka
episodes.synopsis: Their journey takes them from Hakone to Yokohama. They pass by collapsed bridges and see skyscrapers floating in the sea. As the two set out in search of food, an unexpected encounter awaits them.

episodes.title: Setagaya, Shinbashi, Ariake, Tokyo Big Sight
episodes.synopsis: Yoko and Airi get thirsty on their way to Tokyo, so they make a pit stop at Todoroki Ravine in Setagaya. After they quench their thirst, they walk around empty houses looking for food.

episodes.title: Akihabara
episodes.synopsis: The girls visit Akihabara to find the source of Akiba Radio's transmission. As they explore the ruins of the former Electric Town, they come across butler and maid costumes - leading them to have some fun cosplaying.

episodes.title: Nagareyama, Tone River Canal, Kisarazu
episodes.synopsis: They leave Akihabara and head over to Umihotaru, a rest stop on the way from Chiba. The girls run into trouble with the Serow as they struggle to ride it across the expansive wetlands of Nagareyama.

episodes.title: Umihotaru
episodes.synopsis: Leaving a storm in Tokyo Bay's Aqua-Line behind, the girls finally arrive in Umihotaru. They explore the area in the darkness until the rain stops.

episodes.title: Tsukuba
episodes.synopsis: The girls arrive at the Tsukuba Expo Center to carry out some maintenance for Airi. That's when a seemingly ordinary telephone booth there suddenly...

episodes.title: Kasumigaura, Mobility Resort Motegi
episodes.synopsis: The Touringram gets updated, and a stamp function is added. Yoko and Airi head over to Kasumigaura to collect the nearest stamp.

episodes.title: Mobility Resort Motegi
episodes.synopsis: Yoko and Airi want to ride on a circuit, so they head over to Mobility Resort Motegi. There, they encounter ISAAQ, a robot handling reception.

episodes.title: Oarai, Oya, Nikko
episodes.synopsis: The girls' journey brings them to Oarai. After spending a night on a ferry at Oarai Port, they reflect on the journey they could have taken to Hokkaido abroad that very ferry.

episodes.title: Yoshimi Hundred Caves
episodes.synopsis: After leaving Nikko, Airi hears a mysterious sound only she can hear. They head to the origins of that sound, to find out that it's the Yoshimi Hundred Caves in Saitama, a historical site.

episodes.title: Venus Line, Shelter
episodes.synopsis: After camping on the shores of Lake Shirakaba, Yoko and Airi head over to Venus Line, the best touring spot often considered sacred ground among riders. As they emerge from a dense fog, what the two see is—.

episodes.title: Movie 1
episodes.synopsis: With the return of Yang to the battlefield, the Imperial fleet increasingly loses momentum and is now on the verge of collapse. Admiral Kempff has to come to terms with the fact that his forces are no longer capable of holding the front line, and sends an order of general retreat to all ships. But this is not necessarily an admission of defeat, because he has one last card to play.

episodes.title: Movie 2
episodes.synopsis: Kesler reports to Reinhard that the palace has been breached during the night. The sun has yet to rise when Reinhard urgently summons his senior admirals and orders them to keep all fleets ready to go into action at any time. Hilde is now beginning to see the byzantine game of power that is being played in cold-blooded cynicism, but in the midst of this, she overhears communication concerning Neue Sanssouci Chief of Security Molt.

episodes.title: Movie 3
episodes.synopsis: As the new wind of war seems to reinvigorate the will to fight among the Empire's youth, the military machine moves on to mobilize an attack force of unprecedented proportions. At the Supreme Operations Council, Reinhard reveals his audacious plan, not without sparking bewilderment and skepticism among the assembled admirals. Meanwhile, Heydrich Lang, former chief of the much-feared Department of Social Discipline, tries to find himself a role in the new regime, and a replacement for the Imperial throne is about to be announced.

episodes.title: Maze
episodes.synopsis: Count Landsberg's family had loyally served the Goldenbaum dynasty for five generations. His ancestors were even involved in the construction of a labyrinthic system of tunnels beneath the Neue Sanssouci Palace, devised to provide a safe escape for the Emperor in case of an emergency. Now this underground maze will prove instrumental in rescuing the Emperor from the usurper.

episodes.title: Movie 2
episodes.synopsis: Kesler reports to Reinhard that the palace has been breached during the night. The sun has yet to rise when Reinhard urgently summons his senior admirals and orders them to keep all fleets ready to go into action at any time. Hilde is now beginning to see the byzantine game of power that is being played in cold-blooded cynicism, but in the midst of this, she overhears communication concerning Neue Sanssouci Chief of Security Molt.

episodes.title: The Legitimate Galactic Empire Government
episodes.synopsis: In a sudden public speech from Heinessen directed to all citizens, Chairman Trunicht announces that epoch-changing events are occurring as a most unexpected defector has arrived seeking protection under the ideals of freedom and democracy in the Alliance. Everyone on Iserlohn is puzzled, but Yang has a hunch that makes him feel aggravated. Then, news from Odin casts an ominous shadow across the entire galaxy.

episodes.title: Declaration of War
episodes.synopsis: Reinhard's speech has thrown the whole High Council of the Free Planets Alliance into complete chaos. Public opinion is polarized between disapproval of a folly populist decision, and support for a resolution that honors the core values of the Alliance. For Trunicht, there couldn't be better opportunity to further strengthen his influence over the military. As the future of the galaxy seems to hinge upon a bratty seven-year-old, Julian is appointed with a new assignment that would take him right to the eye of the growing storm.

episodes.title: Departure
episodes.synopsis: Julian is deeply hesitant about his new assignment in Fezzan. Wouldn't he be more helpful to the Alliance's cause by staying at Iserlohn, where the Imperial fleet is more likely to strike, making any available pilot sorely needed in the near future? However, Yang believes that this otherwise unwelcome top-down decision may actually turn out to be crucial to obtaining invaluable insight on where the struggle for power in the galaxy is heading.

episodes.title: Movie 3
episodes.synopsis: As the new wind of war seems to reinvigorate the will to fight among the Empire's youth, the military machine moves on to mobilize an attack force of unprecedented proportions. At the Supreme Operations Council, Reinhard reveals his audacious plan, not without sparking bewilderment and skepticism among the assembled admirals. Meanwhile, Heydrich Lang, former chief of the much-feared Department of Social Discipline, tries to find himself a role in the new regime, and a replacement for the Imperial throne is about to be announced.

episodes.title: Operation: Ragnarok
episodes.synopsis: On his way to Fezzan, Julian spends several days at Heinessen. Here, he pays a visit to Bewcock to hand over a strictly confidential letter from Yang, which exposes his conjectures about the possible move the Imperial forces are likely to make. As Julian finally reaches Fezzan, he is immediately mesmerized by the freedom and affluence that surrounds him, and starts seriously wondering whether he will ever be apt to his new mission.

episodes.title: Invitation to a Requiem
episodes.synopsis: A massive fleet led by Oskar von Reuenthal appears in the Iserlohn Corridor. Boasting overwhelming numerical superiority over the defending Alliance forces, the Imperial commander is confident he can crush his opponent in a quick and easy victory. Back on Heinessen, Bewcock warns admirals and MPs that the Empire may be following a less-obvious strategy this time, thus immediate action must be taken to avert the worst. And Yang realizes that his greatest problem of all may not be the approaching enemy ahead, but the supposed friends behind him.

episodes.title: The Occupation of Fezzan
episodes.synopsis: The unexpected stalemate at the Iserlohn Corridor urges the Imperial Headquarters to muster a reinforcement fleet to be immediately sent in support of Reuenthal. Or at least this is what the Imperial crews believe... but as the fleet jumps out from subspace, it becomes clear that Iserlohn is not their destination. Then Mittermeyer, commander of the fleet, announces that they are about to turn the page in the book of history. On Fezzan, people are staring overhead with anxiety as the sky is filled with ships.

info.title: Detective Conan: Episode "Zero" - Shin'ichi Kudo e il caso dell'acquario
info.synopsis: Qualche tempo prima dell'evento al parco di divertimenti che cambierà la sua vita per sempre, Shin'ichi Kudo si trova all'acquario cittadino con la sua amica Ran per discutere di un piano per far rimettere insieme i genitori della ragazza. Tuttavia, mentre si divertono a guardare i pesci, trovano un uomo a terra che è stato pugnalato a morte.

info.title: Baki-dou: The Invincible Samurai (ITA)
info.synopsis: Baki è annoiato. Dopo la conclusione della battaglia epica tra padre e figlio, lui continua a fare combattimenti underground e ad allenarsi senza fermarsi, ma deve sempre reprimere il suo sbadiglio causato dalla noia. Nessuno stimolo o pericolo può portare eccitazione in lui in questo momento. Ora, con l'inclusione del Primo Ministro Giapponese nel circuito, un grande progetto di clonazione di massa sta provando a clonare Miyamoto Musashi, uno dei padri delle arti marziali in Giappone. Un'altra battaglia di proporzioni epiche attende Baki!

related.title: Baki: The Great Raitai Tournament Saga

Baki: The Great Raitai Tournament Saga

episodes.title: The Unstoppable Yawn
episodes.synopsis: With the greatest father-son battle on earth concluded, Baki experiences overwhelming boredom. Meanwhile, Tokugawa advances his unprecedented experiment.

episodes.title: THE BEAT
episodes.synopsis: As the other martial artists battle restlessness, Kaoru Hanayama asks Tokugawa for a favor. Deep underground, the cloning project enters its final phase.

episodes.title: The Countenance of Musashi
episodes.synopsis: As Professor John accepts Sabuko's arcane methods against scientific reasoning, Hanayama gears up for an all-out fistfight with Yujiro on Tokyo's streets.

episodes.title: Boy
episodes.synopsis: After facing Japan's greatest modern swordsman, the peerless Musashi Miyamoto demands the most skilled fighters in the country. Baki steps forward.

episodes.title: Otherworldly Strength
episodes.synopsis: Baki unleashes his fastest strike — but the samurai is faster. Later, as Musashi roams the city, his actions catch the attention of other martial artists.

episodes.title: Real Sword
episodes.synopsis: The first to move is Doppo Orochi. After a brief tussle, he asks Musashi to use a real blade. How will God's Hand fare against the sword saint's steel?

episodes.title: Feather
episodes.synopsis: Sea King Retsu arrives to face Musashi and trains intensively under the watchful eye of Sea Emperor Kaku to master the secret technique: Xiaoli.

episodes.title: You Are Defeated!
episodes.synopsis: The battle between kenpo master Retsu and sword master Musashi Miyamoto begins! While Retsu unleashes long-range weapon attacks, Musashi closes in!?

episodes.title: Sea King Retsu
episodes.synopsis: Barely standing after Musashi's barrage of brutal attacks, Retsu forces his broken body forward and adopts a familiar stance. Can he turn the tide?

episodes.title: Sekigahara
episodes.synopsis: The deathmatch between Retsu and Musashi comes to a devastatingly brutal conclusion. Baki visits Izo Motobe for guidance and flies into a rage.

episodes.title: Buddy
episodes.synopsis: After defeating Japan's kendo champ, Musashi faces jujutsu master Goki Shibukawa, who greets the samurai with a firm handshake — and a punch to the face.

episodes.title: Tough Body
episodes.synopsis: The strongest being on Earth clashes with the strongest samurai in history at the Tokugawa estate! Yujiro demands Musashi face him with two swords.

episodes.title: Practical Fighter
episodes.synopsis: Jack Hammer arrives at the Tokugawa estate hoping to fight Musashi, but first must defeat Motobe, who's determined to be the next to take on the samurai.

info.title: Go For It, Nakamura-kun!!
info.synopsis: Nakamura è un ragazzo timidissimo che si innamora a prima vista di un suo compagno di classe, Hirose. Il problema? I due non si sono neanche mai rivolti la parola e Nakamura è talmente impacciato da rischiare di complicare le cose prima ancora che inizino!

episodes.title: Go For It, Nakamura-kun!! / Super Exciting Cooking Class!!
episodes.synopsis: Shy high school first-year, Nakamura Okuto, falls in love at first sight with his classmate, Hirose Aiki.

episodes.title: Panic! The Secret Bible!!
episodes.synopsis: One morning, the classroom is thrown into chaos when something small and dark scurries across the floor.

episodes.title: Wait, Could This Be Love?!
episodes.synopsis: Nakamura is completely unmotivated to sketch in art class until Hirose is chosen as the model.

episodes.title: The Miraculous Magical Holy Water!
episodes.synopsis: While Nakamura is brooding and emitting a negative aura, he’s recruited by Aokiyama Reiko for her club.

episodes.title: Vexing! Are They an Item?!
episodes.synopsis: Hirose’s rubbing his muscles, sitting in his lap, and holding hands... with a male friend?!

episodes.title: I Want to be "Friends" With You!!
episodes.synopsis: The class takes a field trip to Yokohama’s Chinatown.

episodes.title: Gh-Ghost! School Ghost Stories?!
episodes.synopsis: The Drama/AV Club plans to make a film about the ghost story the whole school is talking about.

episodes.title: Crisis! A Rival Appears?!
episodes.synopsis: Nakamura is overjoyed to walk home with Hirose, but a handsome boy is waiting for them at the gate.

episodes.title: Pursuit! A Cultural Festival on a Starry Night!!
episodes.synopsis: Nakamura yearns to walk around the school festival with Hirose, but instead, he finds himself alone.

episodes.title: A New Discovery! A Study Session After School!! / Super Exciting! Love Bento Autograph Signing!!
episodes.synopsis: Nakamura studies at the library with Hirose and attends the signing event of his favorite author.

episodes.title: Grab It! The Presents Scramble! / Makeover? The Hair Cut Challenge!!
episodes.synopsis: Nakamura shops for a Christmas present for Hirose and accidentally cuts his bangs too short.

episodes.title: You And I Are "Friends"!!
episodes.synopsis: It’s Valentine’s Day, and Nakamura is secretly nervous about giving “friend chocolate” to Hirose.

episodes.title: Even Then, I Love You!
episodes.synopsis: Nakamura learns Hirose has a girlfriend and decides to secretly support them, but...

info.title: Don Dracula (ITA)
info.synopsis: Il Conte Dracula, dopo aver vissuto per anni in Transilvania, è venuto ad abitare a Tokyo con la figlia Ciocolla e si è inserito nella vita giapponese. La figlia va al liceo, ma è costretta a frequentare le scuole serali perché essendo un vampiro non sopporta la luce del sole. Ed è proprio per questo particolare che il terribile dottor Helsing, perennemente a caccia di vampiri, che si è fatto assumere nella scuola come insegnante, riesce ad individuarla e a scoprire quindi anche il padre.

episodes.title: Here Comes the Dracula Killer
episodes.synopsis: For no apparent reason, Don Dracula, the vampire, and his beloved daughter Chocola happen to move to Japan from Romania. They live peacefully in Nerima, a remote area outside Tokyo, until Hellsing, an expert on destroying vampires, comes after them from Holland.

episodes.title: Risky Vampire Tour
episodes.synopsis: Earl Dracula finds it difficult to adjust to Japanese culture, which is very different from Romanian culture. His daughter Chocola, however, looks much happier here than in the boring Romanian castle. Getting anxious about Chocola, who is going to a disco yet again, he also ventures out into the town. There, he and Chocola come into contact with the "Japan Friendship Club of Vampires," but...

episodes.title: The Man in a Frame Who Walks
episodes.synopsis: Inside a parcel delivered to their house at midnight is a portrait of a terribly distorted-looking man. They hang it on the wall, but feel disgusted to look at it. When they try to take it off the wall, they find it is stuck there. Moreover, the man in the picture emerges from the frame and sneaks into Chocola's room.

episodes.title: Where Goes the Half-fish Man?
episodes.synopsis: Chocola and her boyfriend Nobuhiko are strolling on the beach when they find a building called "Research Institute for Exterminating Vampires." Out of curiosity, Chocola and Earl Dracula sneak into the building. Then women made of vinyl appear in front of them. What are they?

episodes.title: Il mistero dello spirito della scuola
Dracula dal dentista
episodes.synopsis: Il Conte Dracula dopo aver vissuto per anni in Transilvania è venuto ad abitare a Tokyo con la figlia Chocolat e si è inserito nella vita giapponese. La figlia va al liceo, ma è costretta a frequentare le scuole serali perché essendo un vampiro non sopporta la luce del sole. Ed è proprio per questo particolare che il terribile dottor Helsing, perennemente a caccia di vampiri, che si è fatto assumere nella scuola come insegnante, riesce ad individuarla e a scoprire quindi anche il padre. Intanto il Conte Dracula, piuttosto imbranato, ha l'estrema necessità di bere il sangue di giovani vergini, ma ogni volta che esce nelle vie della città per questo scopo, rimane coinvolto in numerose strane avventure causate dal fatto che gli abitanti non credono ai vampiri, e non riesce mai nel suo intento.

info.title: Bananya: At-Home Party
info.synopsis: Un gattino si sveglia improvvisamente in un mondo sconosciuto popolato da curiose creature e si rende conto di essersi trasformato lui stesso in un Bananya. Uniti da questo imprevisto, il piccolo e i suoi nuovi compagni intraprendono un viaggio attraverso foreste e montagne, decisi a ritrovare il lucente tesoro perduto di uno di loro.

episodes.title: Bananya: At-Home Party
episodes.synopsis: When I woke up, I was in an unfamiliar world. In front of me was a cat peeking out of a banana, a "Bananya." I couldn't believe my eyes. For some reason, my body was also made of a banana...

info.title: Magical Girl Raising Project: Restart
info.synopsis: Il gioco mortale è tornato! Sedici Ragazze Magiche vengono riunite per affrontare una sfida ad altissimo rischio. Ogni tre giorni, il loro Magical Phone le trascina in una simulazione simile a un RPG, dove dovranno collaborare per sconfiggere nemici, risolvere enigmi e ottenere Magical Candy. Ad attenderle alla fine ci sono ben dieci miliardi di yen, ma il premio spetterà soltanto a chi infliggerà il colpo di grazia. Con una ricompensa così allettante, è solo questione di tempo prima che le ragazze inizino a combattersi tra loro. E quando i loro punti vita raggiungeranno lo zero, il game over sarà solo l'inizio dei loro problemi...

episodes.title: Ciao, Daisy
episodes.synopsis: Pechka è una maga modesta e senza pretese la cui magia le permette di cucinare piatti deliziosi, dote che sfrutta per preparare il pranzo al ragazzo per cui ha una cotta. La sua semplice vita quotidiana viene stravolta del tutto quando viene rapita con la forza e trascinata in un inquietante mondo di gioco. Insieme a Pechka, sono sedici le ragazze magiche radunate lì. In questo spazio virtuale artificiale, si alza in silenzio il sipario su un incubo tanto splendido quanto crudele.

episodes.title: The Players
episodes.synopsis: Sixteen magical girls have been assembled in a vast virtual world. The electronic fairy Fal announces a team competition with a 10-billion-yen grand prize, where players must collect “Candy.” With Pechka panicking over her complete lack of combat ability, Clantail takes the lead in redistributing the Candy. But could this become the seed of quiet mistrust among the group?
